# Javadoc: arguments validator builders (generated by generate-args.sh)

Difficulty: Medium

Depends on: 003. Conventions: `.todo/javadoc-conventions.md` (see "Generated sources").

Shares `scripts/generate-args.sh` with 011. This todo owns only the builder templates; edits stay inside them so that rebases merge cleanly.

## Owned

- `scripts/generate-args.sh` templates for: `builder/ArgumentsValidatorBuilder.java`, `builder/Arguments${i}ValidatorBuilder.java` and `builder/YaviArguments.java` (the `seq 0 ${n}` loop; i=0 is `YaviArguments`)
- Their regenerated outputs in `M/builder/`

The `_string`, `_integer`, ... method families are identical across N and across types: one consistent description per method shape. Generated javadoc must read well for every N.

Doclint regex: `am/ik/yavi/builder/(ArgumentsValidatorBuilder|Arguments\d+ValidatorBuilder|YaviArguments)\.java`

## Reference (read-only)

- `M/arguments/Arguments*Validator.java`, `Arguments*.java` (results of `build()`; owned by 011)
- `M/builder/*ValidatorBuilder.java` typed builders (owned by 010), `M/builder/ValidatorBuilder.java` (009)
- `M/constraint/*Constraint.java` (constraint callbacks)
- `M/validator/Yavi.java` (`Yavi.arguments()` entry point)
- Tests: `T/arguments/ArgumentsValidatorTest.java`, `MethodInvocationTest.java`, `UserValidatorTest.java`, `TK/arguments/ArgumentsValidatorKotlinTest.kt`
